data.name: Noorain
data.gender_notes: Noorain is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Noor' meaning light and 'Ain' meaning eye. Noorain is the light of the moon. In Islamic tradition, it is also associated with the name of Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) daughter, Fatima bint Muhammad (ra), who is a source of guidance and wisdom. The name Noorain carries the meaning “Light of the moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noorain usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of guidance and wisdom from Allah.
data.etymology: Noorain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noorain total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نورين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من النور، يعني المضيئة والمشرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نورين هو جمع مؤنث سالم من النور، وهو مصدر من نور الشيء ينور نورا، فهو نور، والنور في اللغة العربية هو الإضاءة، والحقيقة، والبيان، والهداية، وفي الشريعة الإسلامية، النور هو ما يهدي الناس إلى الطريق المستقيم، ويبعث في قلوبهم الإيمان واليقين، ويسمى الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم نورا، كما في قوله تعالى: {الله نور السماوات والأرض}

in_urdu.name: نورین
in_urdu.meaning: نور سے مشتق، روشن اور چمکدار شخصیت کی مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: نورین ایک عربی نام ہے جو نور سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روشن کرنا، چمکانا، یا کسی چیز کو واضح اور ظاہر کرنا، نام نورین اردو میں بھی مستعمل ہے، جہاں اس کا معنیٰ ہے دو نوروں کی شخصیت، یا دو روشن شخصیات

in_hindi.name: नूरैन
in_hindi.meaning: नूर से व्युत्पन्न, उज्ज्वल और चमकदार व्यक्तित्व की स्वामिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूरैन एक अरबी नाम है जो नूर से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश, उजाला, या किसी वस्तु को स्पष्ट और प्रकट करना, नाम नूरैन हिंदी में भी प्रचलित है, जहां इसका अर्थ है दो नूरों की व्यक्ति, या दो उज्ज्वल व्यक्तित्व

in_pashto.name: نورين
in_pashto.meaning: د نور څخه مشتق، روښانه او ځلنده شخصیت لرونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: نورين د عربي نوم څخه دي چې د نور څخه اخيستل شوي دي، چې مطلب يې د روښنايي، يا د کوم شي روښانه کول، او يا يې واضح او ښکاره کول دي، په پښتو کې، دا نوم د دوه نورونو د شخصيت معنی لري

in_english.name: Noorain
in_english.meaning: Derived from Nur, means radiant, shining, or luminous personality
in_english.long_meaning: Noorain is a derivative of the Arabic word Nur, which means light, illumination, or guidance, in Islamic tradition, Nur is a divine attribute associated with Allah, as mentioned in the Quran, Surah Nur, the name Noorain signifies a person who embodies two sources of light, symbolizing spiritual illumination, wisdom, and inner radiance

data.cultural_impact: The name Noorain has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, holding deep meanings and symbolism. In astronomy, it represents the bright stars or stars on the moon's surface, hence serves as a reminder of the light and guidance that these celestial bodies provide. Moreover, in the context of human relationships, it is reflective of a kind and enlightening person. The name is also used in various literary and artistic works, evoking images of brightness, guidance, and spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Noorain embodies the essence of guidance and enlightenment. It symbolizes the inner light that illuminates the path for individuals on their spiritual journey towards self-improvement and closeness to God. It stands as a reminder of Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) daughter, Fatima bint Muhammad (ra), who is considered a beacon of wisdom and guidance in the Islamic tradition. Her life serves as an inspiring example of how individuals can strive to spiritual growth and embody the highest virtues, and the name Noorain invokes her legacy. Overall, it is a name that carries both profound cultural and spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition.
